decision.reason: [ev-bd0a479f2437] is a one-line changelog entry. It says only that the Loki Helm chart now allows topologySpreadConstraints and points to PR 11086. It does not name the values key path or say which component (write, read, backend, and so on) the setting applies to, so the subject and its exposure condition can't be written. The values validator found no key named topologySpreadConstraints in either release's chart values [ev-6b828f5bc194][ev-72c19aa86056], so P2's top-level path is unsupported. The values excerpts shown contain only "global:". To decide this, we need the PR diff or the chart values that show the actual key paths added.
